photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 10:39:49
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 112 s; on-screen clock 04/10/13 10:39:49, wanted 10:39:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT 13-099  10:39' on 2013-04-09 (`as run matrix!B94`), read as 2013-04-09 10:39. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-09 plus one day, 10:39: it was found 62 s into this video, and in no other video.
